svg.title: Agentic Robotics and Industrial Vision: research overview
svg.desc: Agentic Robotics & Industrial Vision: Agents that plan, coordinate and inspect. Sub-areas: Embodied LLM/VLM agents (Language and vision-language models that plan, reason and act.); Simulation for robot learning (Training scenes and environments generated from language.); Industrial safety robots (Robots that find hazards in factories with no people on site.); Industrial machine vision (Finding tiny defects and locating parts with low-cost cameras.). Open questions: Agents that recover when a plan fails; Reliable vision on low-cost hardware; From simulation to the factory floor.
svg.text: Robots that find hazards in factories
Finding tiny defects and locating parts
